notes.title: Ad Playback Minor Fixed (Relaxed)
notes.content:
[p]Considering the characteristics of Steam platform games,[/p][p]we have slightly relaxed the conditions for ad playback.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Before[/b]
- Everytime clicking "Continue"
- Every other time clicking "Retry"

[b]After[/b]
- Everytime clicking "Continue"
- [strike]Every other time clicking "Retry"[/strike] [b](Removed)[/b]

Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659593/0edc51e0e6c0a94fd513cefd5e0cb54175288316.png"][/img][/p]
